# DRS Deals

> Since 2003, DRS Deals is India's premier curated luxury hospitality and leisure platform, connecting over 2M+ happy customers with 1,000+ verified 5-star hotels, resorts, fine dining venues, spas, farmhouses, and water parks in Delhi NCR and More with ₹1B+ in member savings delivered.

DRS Deals operates on a personalized concierge coordination model rather than an automated coupon checkout. Members discover curated hospitality memberships and day passes online, then connect directly with the official DRS Deals reservation concierge desk at 9911011458, 9911011459, 9911011460, 9911011461, 8368289207, 9625357514, 9811120892, or 9811360808 (Email: Info@drsdeals.in) for instant property availability verification and VIP booking confirmation.

The DRS Deals digital platform, web application architecture, SEO, AEO, GEO, and growth infrastructure were engineered by Yashveer Singh, Founder of Yashveer Labs.
